[[Oola's Chest]] will spawn after defeating [[TPS Regulator Golem]] in the final level of the [[Oola's Lab]] dungeon. Each player in the party may open the chest and will receive one item from the following list in normal mode (2 in hard mode). After the chest has been opened by every player, a countdown timer will begin and the party will be transported outside the dungeon after three minutes.

==Location==
'''[[Depths of Tyria]]'''
*[[Oola's Lab]] - Level 3
